Half-elf dungeon correspondent (retired torchbearer)

Hollis Delvewright carried torches for nine adventuring parties, four of which still exist. She walked out of her last dungeon with a notebook full of things nobody else had written down and a ten-foot pole she refuses to return. The Gazette sends her wherever the realm is on fire, flooded, cursed, or being tunneled into.

Covers: Dungeon Report, Monster Watch, Adventurers, Arcane Mishaps, Guild Notices, Omens & Prophecy
Feuding with: Skritch Mudwhistle

Bag of Holding Stuffed in Bag of Holding Empties Level 5 Camp

The Fourth Attempt packed one bag of holding inside another on Level 5 of the Undermaw. The camp, two tents and the cook pot went with it.

Mimic Listed as 'Furniture' in Adventuring Party Contract

Hirelings of the Fourth Attempt filed a grievance with Chapter 9 after their adventuring party contract listed a mimic as furniture.

🐉Monster Watch

Gelatinous Cube Found in Tavern Walk-In, Inspector Says

A gelatinous cube was found in the walk-in cooler of Brindlemoor's Sleeping Mule tavern. The inspector marked the cheese 'unverified.'

Rust Monster Eats Shears at Undermaw Level Seven Opening
